surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 5 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Fil (The Elephant) is the 105th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 5 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم تر كيف فعل ربك باصحاب الفيل
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did He not make their plan into misguidance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did He not utterly confound their plans

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He sent against them birds in flocks
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He sent ranks of birds against them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Striking them with stones of hard clay
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He made them like eaten straw
